// purpose: Type-check the @c15r/editor cell client against the real CodeMirror 6 packages. Cell sources are otherwise unchecked by the build (tsconfig.json covers bin/lib/platform/services; tsconfig.client.json covers platform/ui + services/**/client), and this cell is the one place we depend on a large third-party API surface — so its imports are pinned by the compiler rather than by hope. The @codemirror/* devDependencies exist for THIS check; at runtime the cell bundler externalizes them to the esm.sh pins in client/imports.json.
